meta.task: I want to listen to music

issues: unmirrored: Music Player: Lyrics And Track Info Panel -> Music Player: Now Playing Transport Bar

defs.name: Music Player: Library Browser Grid
defs.genInstructions: Build a scrollable browsing surface of the user's music library with a search field, filter tabs (Songs/Albums/Artists/Playlists), sortable track rows and album art tiles, plus per-item play and 'add to queue' actions. It is the primary discovery surface that feeds tracks into playback and the queue.
defs.role: The library's discovery and search surface that selects which track plays and what gets appended to the queue.

effectors.name: Music Player: Queue Side Panel
effectors.description: When the currently playing item changes via the queue (user clicks a queue row or a track auto-advances), the queue emits the active track ID and the browser highlights that row/tile as 'now playing' and scrolls it into view if its containing list is displayed.

targets.name: Music Player: Now Playing Transport Bar
targets.description: Double-clicking a track row/tile or pressing its play button emits the full track object (id, title, artist, album, artworkUrl, durationMs, audioSrc); the transport bar loads it, resets the seek position to 0 and begins playback, updating its metadata readout.

targets.name: Music Player: Queue Side Panel
targets.description: Clicking 'Add to Queue' on a track, album or playlist emits an ordered array of track objects that the queue appends to its list; double-clicking a track instead emits a 'play now' payload that the queue uses to replace the upcoming list with that track's album/playlist context and mark it active.

defs.name: Music Player: Now Playing Transport Bar
defs.genInstructions: Build a persistent bottom transport bar with play/pause, previous/next, shuffle, repeat, a scrubbable progress bar with elapsed/total time, current track metadata with thumbnail art, a volume slider with mute, and a like button. It is the central playback control for the whole UI.
defs.role: The central playback engine and transport control that every other component either drives or reads its state from.

effectors.name: Music Player: Library Browser Grid
effectors.description: Receives a full track object when the user plays an item from the library; loads the audio source, resets elapsed time and starts playback while swapping in the new title/artist/artwork.

effectors.name: Music Player: Queue Side Panel
effectors.description: Receives the next/selected track when the user clicks a queue row or reorders/removes the upcoming item; loads and plays it, and supplies the queue with playback-ended events so it can auto-advance.

targets.name: Music Player: Queue Side Panel
targets.description: Emits playback state changes — track ended, next/previous pressed, shuffle toggled, repeat mode changed — so the queue advances its pointer, marks the new active row, re-randomizes upcoming order on shuffle, and re-inserts the current track when repeat-one is on.

targets.name: Music Player: Album Art Visualizer Stage
targets.description: Streams current track metadata (artwork URL, title, artist, dominant color), play/pause state and elapsed-time ticks; the stage swaps artwork with a crossfade, recolors its backdrop, and starts/stops the animated waveform in sync with playback and volume level.

targets.name: Music Player: Lyrics And Track Info Panel
targets.description: Emits the current track ID plus a continuous playback position (ms); the panel loads that track's lyrics and credits and auto-scrolls/highlights the lyric line matching the current timestamp, and seeks the transport when a lyric line is clicked back.

defs.name: Music Player: Queue Side Panel
defs.genInstructions: Build a side panel listing the now-playing track and upcoming queue with drag-to-reorder rows, remove buttons, a clear-queue action, and a recently-played history tab. It manages playback order for the transport bar.
defs.role: The playback order manager that stores, reorders and hands the next track to the transport bar.

effectors.name: Music Player: Library Browser Grid
effectors.description: Receives appended track arrays from 'Add to Queue' actions, or a 'play now' context that replaces the upcoming list and sets the active index to the chosen track.

effectors.name: Music Player: Now Playing Transport Bar
effectors.description: Receives track-ended, next/previous, shuffle and repeat events; advances or rewinds the active pointer, reshuffles upcoming order, repeats the current track, and moves finished tracks into the history tab.

targets.name: Music Player: Now Playing Transport Bar
targets.description: Emits the selected track object when a queue row is clicked or when the pointer advances, causing the transport bar to load and play it; also emits the updated next-track reference after any drag-reorder or removal.

targets.name: Music Player: Library Browser Grid
targets.description: Broadcasts the active track ID whenever it changes so the library highlights the matching row or tile as currently playing.

defs.name: Music Player: Album Art Visualizer Stage
defs.genInstructions: Build a large hero stage showing the current track's album artwork with a crossfade on change, an animated audio waveform/bar visualizer, a color-adaptive gradient backdrop, and large title/artist typography. It is the ambient focal display of the player.
defs.role: The immersive visual focal point that renders the currently playing track's artwork and audio motion driven by the transport bar.

effectors.name: Music Player: Now Playing Transport Bar
effectors.description: Receives current artwork URL, title, artist, play/pause state, volume level and elapsed-time ticks; crossfades artwork on track change, recolors the gradient from the artwork's dominant color, and animates or freezes the visualizer bars according to play state and amplitude.

defs.name: Music Player: Lyrics And Track Info Panel
defs.genInstructions: Build a panel with a time-synced scrolling lyrics view where the active line is highlighted and clickable to seek, plus a tab for track credits, album, release year and genre. It adds depth and navigation to the currently playing track.
defs.role: The contextual detail surface that displays synced lyrics and metadata for the transport bar's current track and can seek it.

effectors.name: Music Player: Now Playing Transport Bar
effectors.description: Receives the current track ID and continuous playback position in ms; loads matching lyrics and credits and highlights/auto-scrolls to the lyric line whose timestamp range contains the current position.

targets.name: Music Player: Now Playing Transport Bar
targets.description: When a lyric line is clicked, emits that line's start timestamp; the transport bar seeks playback to that position and continues playing.
